# Three.js WebGL 1 compatibility engine

Pinned upstream `three@0.162.0`, MIT license. This is the last Three.js release
with WebGL 1 support. The anatomy viewer dynamically loads this engine when a
WebGL 2 context cannot be created; normal WebGL 2 devices retain r180.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.162.0.tgz
